These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Assumptions, units and boundaries Use gamma = 0.2, omega = 3, initial state (1, 0), and T = 2. Three paired relative and absolute tolerances with two maximum steps, plus two terminal runs, give eight runs. Editorial clarification There is no general guarantee for tangential roots, multiple crossings within a step or systems with resets. Initial-zero and ownership controls are limited component tests; local tolerances and global accuracy remain distinct. Axes for trajectories, states, time or iterations do not represent physical spatial dimensions. Adopted numerical method Use actual Dormand–Prince 5(4) stages, a quartic continuous extension, an accepted-state derivative cache and bracket bisection on retained interpolants.
